heading: A process in
subtitle: From audit to acceptance, a controlled roadmap
approach_desc: Each project is managed by experienced engineers, with rigorous monitoring at each phase to guarantee quality and deadlines.
desc1: Needs analysis, existing infrastructure audit, definition of technical scope and field constraints.
desc2: Technical plan development, infrastructure sizing, design validation with the client.
desc3: Team mobilization, equipment installation, cabling and commissioning of infrastructures.
desc4: Performance testing, contractual KPI validation, corrections and optimizations before acceptance.
